req.title: Task description optional
req.statement: The system shall accept POST /tasks/ payloads without a description field.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-017 requires that POST /tasks/ accepts payloads without a description field. Three test cases are designed: (1) positive EP test — omit description entirely, expect HTTP 201 and description=null in response; (2) negative NEG test — send a payload with only description (no title), expect HTTP 422 since title is required; (3) boundary BVA test — send description=null explicitly alongside a valid title, expect HTTP 201 and description=null. Each test uses exact-value assertions to maximise mutation kill rate, covering status code constants (201, 422), field presence/absence, and the Optional[str] None default.

tests.name: test_create_task_without_description_field_omitted
preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: POST /tasks/ with JSON body containing only 'title' (no description key)
expected: Response JSON 'title' equals the submitted title
trace: R-TASK-017: system shall accept POST /tasks/ payloads without a description field
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_without_description_field_omitted():
    payload = {"title": "Task without description"}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert body["title"] == "Task without description"
    assert body["description"] is None
    assert body["completed"] is False
    assert "created_at" in body
    assert body["created_at"] is not None

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_description_only_no_title_rejected():
    payload = {"description": "A description with no title"}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    # Confirm the validation error references the missing 'title' field
    detail_str = str(body["detail"])
    assert "title" in detail_str

def test_create_task_empty_body_rejected():
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={})
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    # Must not be 201 or any 2xx
    assert r.status_code != 201
